content.value: How to determine “Debit" and “Credit" of account.

2Firoz Kazi is a lawyer practicing in Dhaka Judge Court. He starts a sole proprietorship law firm in the name of Kazi Legal Services. During the first month of operation April 2023, Kazi engages in the following transactions.

content.value_html:
2023April 1Kazi invested TK 2,00,000 cash to begin the firm.
April 2Purchased office supplies on account at a cost of TK 2,500.
April 3Furniture purchased for office use TK 60,000 in cash.
April 4Deals a case for one client and received cash TK 9,000.
April 5Cash paid to creditor transaction April-2.
April 6Advertisement bill received but not paid TK 5,000.
April 7Utility bill received and paid in cash TK 500.
April 9Pay TK 1,000 cash from personal fund for a personal trip to Rajshahi.
April 10Kazi withdraw cash of TK 2,500 for personal use from the firm.
April 12Cash paid for advertisement bill transaction April-6
Required:(a) Prepare Journal(b) Prepare a tabular summary and show the effects on accounting equation.Kazi uses the chart of accounts: Cash + supplies + furniture = Accounts payable +Kazi Capital. Other revenue expense and income are: Advertisement expense,Utility expense, Fees earned account.
